family: All Boolean truth tables on n=0,1,2,3; disjoint tensors of all n=2 truth tables; balanced n=1 cores activated with r=1,2,3
domain: n fixed at 0 through 3; tensor factors fixed at n=2; activation fixed at r=1 through 3
arithmetic: Integer direct Walsh transform and independent FWHT; Fraction spectral probabilities and influence; entropy represented exactly as rational linear combinations of log2(primes)
purpose: Validate algebraic restriction/tensor/activation identities, not prove a logarithmic sign or rank ratios
